text:
The price is very good, the clinic is clean, and the medical assistants provide good service.
However, the staff member we spoke with lacked thorough information and seemed focused on sales, providing information that clearly contradicted the label on the product. Despite this, they still argued with the information on the box. The rest of their recommendations lacked credibility. The doctor who performed the procedure also rushed and lacked attention to detail or consultation with the client. As a result, there were several uneven areas on my face that were clearly visible, even after the swelling had subsided. Thankfully, the clinic said they would take responsibility and cover the unevenness free of charge.
Overall, the price is good, the clinic is beautiful, and they show initial responsibility, but both the doctor and the sales representative we consulted with lacked attention to detail in their work.
